model: The marker signature sorted and joined the display id list on every render, including a pan that reused the same list. That sorted string is stored on the list. A new list still sorts once.

noise.rule: 1529 is round(200 * log2(200)). 200 is an example, not a live Seoul sample. The first use of a list still builds a set, sorts, and joins. Not a sampled profiler trace.
